# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# Define center position for the main component (U1)
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 150.0, 150.0

# Place the LCD module (U1)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Display_Character",
    symbol_name="LCD-016N002L",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="U1",
    value="LCD-016N002L",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place the 1N4148 diode (R1) to the left of U1
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Diode",
    symbol_name="1N4148",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 50,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="R1",
    value="1N4148",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place the first small diode (D1) below R1
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="D_Small",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 50,
    pos_y=center_y_1 - 30,
    reference="D1",
    value="D_Small",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place the second small diode (C1) to the right of U1 (unused in connections)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="D_Small",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 30,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="C1",
    value="D_Small",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Connect U1 VDD (pin 2) to R1 A (pin 2)
connect_pins("U1", "2", "R1", "2")

# Connect U1 VSS (pin 1) to R1 K (pin 1)
connect_pins("U1", "1", "R1", "1")

# Connect R1 K (pin 1) to D1 A (pin 2)
connect_pins("R1", "1", "D1", "2")

# Connect U1 RS (pin 4) to D1 A (pin 2)
connect_pins("U1", "4", "D1", "2")

# Connect U1 E (pin 6) to D1 K (pin 1)
connect_pins("U1", "6", "D1", "1")

# Connect U1 RW (pin 5) to D1 K (pin 1)
connect_pins("U1", "5", "D1", "1")

# Connect U1 LED+ (pin 15) to D1 A (pin 2)
connect_pins("U1", "15", "D1", "2")

# Write out all wires
write_out_all_wires()
